# Project guidelines

The rules for changing this repository are in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root.
They apply to every agent and every human contributor, so read that file before changing
anything. Each rule there names the test or CI step that enforces it. A rule that nothing enforces
yet is marked HAZARD and links its issue.

Do not restate those rules here. Keeping one copy of each rule stops the copies from drifting
apart. Open work lives in GitHub issues, not in repository markdown.
